name: Dantes
source:
He was originally from a family that held high-ranking priesthood within the True Norn Church, but fell victim to a scheme by the current Pope Alexis, and was framed for a crime he did not commit, and his entire family was killed.

He narrowly escaped execution, and on the run, his hatred for the church grew, he met Elide, the goddess of desire, and founded the "Cult of Nemesia" as a means of revenge.

When acting as the head of the cult, he wears a half-mask that was given powers by Elide, and he has come to be known as "Dantès of the Angry Mask."

He will use any means to achieve his goals, and is shrewd and ruthless in all his actions. He is single-minded about his goal of revenge, and stoically pursues his goal.
